messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: gpupool-1 (eu-west-1) saturation detected — queue length >200, autoscaler failed to add replicas. Incident severity: P1. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/gpu/pools/gpupool-1

sam_oncall: paging oncall. I'm taking this first pass. starting triage.

maya_sre: I'm looking. queue growth timeline: 12 -> 340 reqs in 8m. GPU mem at ~98%. p95 lat jumped 10s -> 46s.

leo_ml: fyi we rolled concise-chat v2.4.1 ~9m ago and bumped default context to 16k (from 8k) to support a customer prompt set. kv-cache miss rate exploded after rollout.

nora_platform: autoscaler logs show: "cannot scale: pool.quota.max_replicas=10 reached". current_replicas=10. No new nodes requested because quota enforced by infra policy.

sam_oncall: so two problems: rollout increased per-request memory/throughput -> GPUs saturated; autoscaler blocked by hard cap. customers impacted?

tomi_cs: CS reports two enterprise customers seeing streaming timeouts and 503s since ~09:12 UTC. Support ticket IDs #23456 and #23461. They're seeing partial responses then disconnect.

maya_sre: digging into runtime logs — a lot of KV cache warmup misses and frequent cache invalidations due to larger context windows. That increases KV cache hotset and memory pressure. stack traces show model OOMs and then pods restarting.

devops-bot: recent events: [09:09] deploy concise-chat v2.4.1 by leo_ml; [09:13] autoscaler attempted scale to 13 but blocked by quota; [09:14] 8 pods entered crashloopbackoff.

sam_oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) throttle rollout traffic to old model variant or 2) temporarily increase pool quota or 3) rollback the rollout. Need decision fast.

leo_ml: we can flip a canary to v2.4.0 (previous) instantly. v2.4.1 has the new default context param; a quick rollback removes the change. If rollback is fastest, I can do it now.

nora_platform: we can request temporary quota bump from infra team but that takes ~15-30m. manual override to increase pool to 12 via infra console is possible if infra okays.

maya_sre: suggested immediate step: flip traffic for the high-traffic routes back to v2.4.0 canary and start draining the overloaded pods. That should reduce KV miss rate and free memory.

sam_oncall: agreed. leo, perform rollback to v2.4.0 canary for concise-chat production traffic. post the command you run.

leo_ml: rolling back canary now. command: ```rctl rollout set concise-chat --env prod --target-version v2.4.0 --strategy canary --weight 100```

devops-bot: NOTE: rollout change accepted, traffic switch initiated.

maya_sre: I'm watching metrics. queue dropping from 340 -> 120 in next 5m. GPU mem usage falling slowly. new pods still in crashloop but should stabilize as workload decreases.

sam_oncall: also opening a mitigation task to add a temporary autoscaler quota increase. nora, can you kick off infra-request? mention it's P1 and customer-impacting.

nora_platform: filed request IR-7892 to infra with tags urgent/p1. request: bump gpupool-1 max_replicas to 14 for 2 hours. ETA from infra is ~22m.

tomi_cs: I'll send an interim update to affected customers: we're investigating increased latency and timeouts, rolling back a recent model change, expect recovery within 10-15m.

maya_sre: Customer impact note: estimated 2 enterprise customers with high-volume streaming saw up to 60% request failures; non-enterprise saw transient slowdowns. No data loss.

sam_oncall: good. keep this channel for live updates only; move longer notes to incident doc later.

(5m later)

devops-bot: autoscaler attempted scale again at 09:36 but still blocked until infra approves.

maya_sre: queue near 40 now. GPU memory per pod dropping to ~75%. crashloop count decreasing. p95 latency back to ~12s and trending down.

leo_ml: can confirm rollback removed the aggressive context setting. We're gating the large-context feature behind an explicit config flag now; will follow-up with a safer rollout plan.

sam_oncall: infra request approved: gpupool-1 max_replicas bumped to 14 until 11:00 UTC. nora, please confirm.

nora_platform: confirmed. I've increased the quota and unblocked autoscaler. autoscaler is now able to scale to 12.

maya_sre: autoscaler added 2 replicas -> current_replicas=12. queue settled at ~10. GPUs healthy.

sam_oncall: taking notes for post-incident: root cause = model rollout with increased context default -> kv-cache miss spike -> GPU mem pressure -> pod OOMs -> queue growth; autoscaler couldn't scale because of hard quota. Contributing: missing canary for context size, no automatic throttle for high-kv-miss workloads.

leo_ml: action items from ML: 1) add config flag and integrate context-size gating behind canary; 2) baseline kv-cache warmup tests for new model variants.

nora_platform: infra action: 1) revisit default max_replicas limits vs emergency increase paths; 2) add autoscaler alert when blocked by quota.

maya_sre: ops action: add a runbook step to throttle new model variants when mem/kv-miss exceeds threshold; add automated fallback to model variant with smaller context.

tomi_cs: CS action: follow up with customers post-incident with timeline and mitigation.

sam_oncall: moving to recovery mode. we'll draft incident report and assign owners. handing off to maya for follow-up rotation.

maya_sre: taking over for follow-up and postmortem. I'll set up an incident doc and ping owners. closing live channel status: recovering but remain in monitoring for 2 hours.

sam_oncall: Thanks team. Closing live page for now — oncall handoff complete.

devops-bot: Incident summary saved to https://incidents.redwood/1865432100 and notification queued to #postmortems."
